description: Phase A expected-failure baseline for the DS-A-01 delivery I1 (A-00 candidate I0 + integration fixes). Only defects still open after DS-A-01 remain here; save/load and comms restoration belong to DS-A-03..A-06. Consumed by run_tests.ps1 -BaselineExtra; each case status stays FAIL (never PASS/skipped/hidden). The Phase 0 file is NOT touched by Phase A.
baseline_commit_note: DS-A-01 I1 = A-00 head 882e058 + DS-A-01 integration fixes (snapshot catalog source, ballistics catalog authority, player-view truth withholding, geometry advisory/unavailable modes) + a0_integration_authority probe.
related: docs/57_DeepSeek_PhaseA_任务队列与首批任务卡.md
evidence_provenance: Independently executed on I1 through the real product entry (main_menu -> v1_hud -> ShellBinder -> GameSession, DSH_BUILD=orbital_sim). Counts deterministic across repeated runs. Every entry is a real, still-open defect reproduced on I1.
notes: A0-T1 (45/0) and the new integration.a0_integration_authority (61/0) PASS on I1 and are NOT listed here.

A0-T2 was REMOVED from this baseline on I1: the DS-A-01 fixes make it PASS 30/0 (snapshot entity_catalog source block, ballistics catalog authority for rcs/ir, player-view truth withholding). Removal is backed by the DS-A-01 phaseA run log, not by relaxing assertions.
Phase 0 gate semantics are unchanged: -Gate phase0 never reads this file.
This file must never be merged into game_v17/tests/known_baseline_failures.json.

failures.reason: A0-T3 (unchanged from DS-A-00): (a) live HUD session save->load fails with replay send_comms no_route (DS-A-06); (b) restored runtime event seq is a float instead of a real GDScript int, 27 occurrences (DS-A-03); (c) save payload carries no sensor_service runtime snapshot and (d) EMCON/radar state plus full channel content are lost on load (DS-A-05). Raw-JSON numeric contract, physics/world/track numeric roundtrip, identification int config and save->load->save canonical equality all pass.
